Title: LMTY Wellness Drops
Body (HTML):
The cozy, feel-good cup you used to drive for, in a dropper. Bright lemon drops with a touch of green tea and zero added sugar.

How to use: shake well, add one full dropper (about 2 mL) to hot or cold water or your favorite tea, stir and sip.

Size: 2 fl oz (60 mL) glass dropper bottle, about 30 servings.
